cohort.baseline: Fit one unrestricted complex 2x2 linear response per yaw from all measured pitch+azimuth fixed-frame input vectors at the excited fundamental, using both directions. A comparable amplitude-dependent complex response must beat it on untouched amplitudes. Price singular values/condition and measured forcing amplitude/phase/block variability before interpretation; hardware latency not known solely by shared timestamps. Roster frozen first, source-clock qualification and estimator/scorer freeze next before any pitch/load array. Force estimates from held input allowed after freeze, held moments remain escrow until predictions are locked.
